crossRefs.note: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn…
It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.
For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according…
Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,

translations.web: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.
translations.bsb: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.
translations.kjv: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep
translations.asv: they shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break a bone thereof: according to all the statute of the passover they shall keep it.
